name: dithered
label: Dithered
css: .style-dithered { --slide-primary: #3B82F6; --slide-secondary: #8B5CF6; --slide-surface: #FFFFFF; --slide-text: #111827; --slide-success: #16A34A; --slide-warning: #D97706; --slide-danger: #DC2626; background: var(--slide-surface); background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 4px 4px; background-position: 0 0; color: var(--slide-text); font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 64px 48px; box-sizing: border-box; } .style-dithered::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.04) 100%); pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; } .style-dithered > * { position: relative; z-index: 2; } .style-dithered .hook { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -2px; color: var(--slide-primary); margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; } .style-dithered .text { font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text); margin: 0; } .style-dithered .step { position: absolute; top: 48px; right: 48px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary); opacity: 0.12; line-height: 1; margin: 0; } .style-dithered .brand { font-family: 'Open Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-text); letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0; } .slide-code.style-dithered { --slide-primary: #3B82F6; --slide-surface: #0F172A; --slide-text: #F1F5F9; background: var(--slide-surface); background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 4px 4px; background-position: 0 0; } .slide-code.style-dithered::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15) 0%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08) 100%); } .slide-code.style-dithered .hook { color: #60A5FA; } .slide-code.style-dithered .step { color: #60A5FA; } .slide-insight.style-dithered { --slide-primary: #8B5CF6; --slide-surface: #1F0F3D; --slide-text: #F1F5F9; background: var(--slide-surface); background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.35) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 4px 4px; background-position: 0 0; } .slide-insight.style-dithered::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.18) 0%, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1) 100%); } .slide-insight.style-dithered .hook { color: #C4B5FD; } .slide-insight.style-dithered .step { color: #C4B5FD; } .slide-insight.style-dithered .insight-text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; color: #F1F5F9; line-height: 1.4; }
